candidate_evidence.quote: Addition of Anlotinib Hydrochloride to the Stupp Regimen Versus the Stupp Regimen Alone for Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma: A Randomized Double-blind Multicenter Prospective Phase II Study

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Addition of Anlotinib Hydrochloride to the Stupp Regimen Versus the Stupp Regimen Alone for Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma: A Randomized Double-blind Multicenter Prospective Phase II Study

role_evidence.quote: Patients will receive standard radiation therapy plus temozolomide (Stupp regimen). Anlotinib hydrochloride will be given with a daily dose of 10 mg for 14 days of a 21-day cycle up to 2 cycles

agents.drug_class_hint: multi-target tyrosine kinase inhibitor (VEGFR/PDGFR/FGFR), approved in China

role_evidence.quote: Temozolomide will be administered at a daily dose of 75 mg/m2 until the completion of radiation therapy.

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent (established GBM therapy), Stupp regimen

role_evidence.quote: [PLACEBO_COMPARATOR] control group: Experimental: Radiation therapy, Temozolomide and Placebo

coder_notes: IDH1/2 mutation is an exclusion criterion, i.e. IDH-wildtype required, hence cns5_terminology cns5 and IDH eligibility biomarker (not candidate-matched). Anlotinib dose differs between arm description (10 mg) and intervention description (12 mg). Placebo listed as a registered DRUG intervention with role control_comparator. Control arm is a registered PLACEBO_COMPARATOR.
